description: Prepare for a disability or illness benefit assessment (a functional or work capability assessment, a medical review, a disability evaluation interview): describe how the condition affects daily life on a bad day, gather evidence, and know what to bring and say. Use when someone says 'I have a benefit assessment next week', 'how do I prepare for my disability assessment', 'they say I can do more than I can', or 'what should I say at my medical review'.
